text_block_list.text:
"Training is about to begin,
but Vodka doesn't seem to be feeling well..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "N-No way in hell! I refuse! As if I'd ever do something that uncool!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Pushing through the pain to better yourself—
now that's what being cool is all about!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry up and start training!
I can totally power through this!

...And though she managed to start training,
Vodka found herself plagued by a headache.
